abstract: Forty-eight patients with advanced testicular cancer, defined as abdominal mass greater than 10 cm, mediastinal mass greater than 5 cm, more than 20 lung metastases, or visceral organ involvement were treated with an intensive, alternating five-drug regimen consisting of cisplatin 50 mg/m2 d 1-3, etoposide 170 mg/m2 d 1-3, ifosfamide 5 g/m2 d 15, vincristine 2 mg weekly, bleomycin 15 mg/m2 weekly, q d 28. Thirty-four (71%) of the patients attained tumor-free status. This was achieved by chemotherapy alone in 14 patients and by surgical resection of residual disease in the remaining 20 patients (histology of resected tissue: necrosis 12, mature teratoma 7, viable carcinoma 1). Patients with pure seminoma responded better than patients with nonseminoma (CR 100% vs. 67%, respectively). In a univariate analysis only the value of HCG (less than vs greater than 10,000 U/L) and the number of involved organ sites (less than or equal to 2 vs greater than to 2) had significant influence on the response rate. After a minimum follow-up of 24 months 3 patients (9%) have relapsed. The survival rate is 76% after 36 months, with 61% remaining disease-free. Though this intensive regimen might bestow some of the therapeutic advantages of standard three-drug protocols in far advanced testicular cancer, the results are still less than optimal and warrant the exploration of new therapeutic strategies.
abstract_ja: 腹部腫瘤が10cm超、縦隔腫瘤が5cm超、肺転移が20個超、または臓器浸潤を有する進行精巣がんの患者48例を対象とした。対象者には、強化型の交互投与5剤併用療法を施行した。その内容は、シスプラチン50 mg/m² 1-3日目、エトポシド170 mg/m² 1-3日目、イホスファミド5 g/m² 15日目、ビンクリスチン2 mg 毎週、ブレオマイシン15 mg/m² 毎週、28日ごとである。34例（71%）が無腫瘍状態に達した。化学療法単独で14例、残存病変の外科的切除を行った20例であった（切除組織の組織像：壊死12例、成熟奇形腫7例、生存癌1例）。セミノーマ患者は非セミノーマ患者より良好な反応を示した（CR 100%対67%）。単変量解析では、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値（10,000 U/L未満対以上）と病変臓器数（2箇所以下対3箇所以上）のみが奏効率に有意な影響を与えた。24か月以上の最短追跡後、3例（9%）が再発した。36か月生存率は76%、無病生存は61%であった。本強化療法は進行精巣がんにおける標準3剤レジメンの治療上の利点を一部有するかもしれないが、結果はなお最適とは言えず、新たな治療戦略の検討が必要である。
